description: This file is a part of the Twig templating engine, specifically a token parser that handles 'import' statements used for importing macros and variables within Twig templates.

classes.name: ImportTokenParser
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractTokenParser to implement parsing logic specifically for the 'import' statement in Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'import' token to create an ImportNode, handling macro import syntax and scope assignment.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'import', which is the token name this parser handles.
